verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows Medusa hosting an MCP server (docs.medusajs.com/mcp) that external AI tools like Cursor can connect to for documentation lookup — this is Medusa acting as an MCP server provider, not evidence that Medusa itself can consume/plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. No documentation or community evidence describes Medusa (or its Cloud Development Agent) connecting to external MCP servers as a client.
